caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair centered on a plain, light-colored background. The chair features a carved backrest with an elegant vase-shaped splat and gently curved vertical supports, with the top rail forming a wavy, crest-like outline that flares out at the ends. The seat is square and appears to be made of woven material in a golden-yellow hue, with shading that suggests texture. The legs are cabriole-shaped, curving outward at the top and inward toward the feet, with the front legs ending in slight scrolls. The back legs extend straight downward. The chair has three stretchers: two are straight and connect the side legs, while the central one, connecting the front and rear legs, is more decorative with a diamond shape in the middle. The colors of the wooden parts consist mainly of various shades of brown, with subtle highlights and shadowing, giving depth and a sense of grain to the material. The background is a simple, unadorned off-white or pale beige, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Sheraton Chair
